sun_conjunction_moon.title: Sun Conjunct Moon
sun_conjunction_moon.summary: Fuses ego and emotion, creating a highly self-willed and focused nature.
sun_conjunction_moon.fullText: This aspect blends the core identity (Sun) with emotional needs (Moon). It creates a powerful focal point in the chart, leading to a stubborn and self-willed nature. You may have a somewhat one-sided personality driven by very deep-rooted habits.

sun_opposition_moon.title: Sun Opposite Moon
sun_opposition_moon.summary: Brings internal strain and polarity between the ego and emotional comforts.
sun_opposition_moon.fullText: The opposition brings strain and discordance, pitting your conscious will against your unconscious emotional needs. It highlights inner conflicts and contradictory actions, but acts as a powerful challenge to achieve personal growth and psychological balance.

sun_square_moon.title: Sun Square Moon
sun_square_moon.summary: Creates stressful inner conflicts and emotional oversensitivity.
sun_square_moon.fullText: This challenging aspect places obstacles between your ego and your feelings. It brings inner conflicts about the self and deep insecurity. Your actions are often contradictory, and you may be emotionally oversensitive as you learn to reconcile these tense energies.

sun_trine_moon.title: Sun Trine Moon
sun_trine_moon.summary: Indicates a well-integrated personality and a harmonious, flowing life.
sun_trine_moon.fullText: This harmonious aspect represents an easy, flowing energy between the conscious identity and unconscious emotions. It creates a well-integrated personality that is adaptable to others. It often brings a harmonious home life and innate creative talents.

sun_sextile_moon.title: Sun Sextile Moon
sun_sextile_moon.summary: Brings opportunities for emotional and personal balance through effort.
sun_sextile_moon.fullText: The sextile is a favorable aspect that indicates harmony and compatibility between your ego and feelings. It brings opportunities for a well-rounded life, provided you make the conscious effort to act on your potential.

sun_quincunx_moon.title: Sun Quincunx Moon
sun_quincunx_moon.summary: Requires continual adjustment between identity and emotional needs.
sun_quincunx_moon.fullText: This aspect connects incompatible signs, causing unpredictable strain. You must make continual, uncomfortable adjustments between what your ego demands and what your heart needs for comfort, often impacting your physical vitality or health.

sun_conjunction_mercury.title: Sun Conjunct Mercury
sun_conjunction_mercury.summary: Fuses identity with intellect, creating a strong but potentially rigid mind.
sun_conjunction_mercury.fullText: Because the Sun and Mercury are never more than 28 degrees apart, this is their primary aspect. It blends the ego and the mind perfectly. If very tight (under 5 degrees), you are apt to be highly intelligent but rigid and dogmatic in your opinions.

sun_semisextile_mercury.title: Sun Semisextile Mercury
sun_semisextile_mercury.summary: A mildly favorable blend of ego and communication.
sun_semisextile_mercury.fullText: This minor aspect brings slight opportunities to align your core identity with your communication style. It indicates a mental interaction that requires subtle adjustments to fully express your ideas.

sun_conjunction_venus.title: Sun Conjunct Venus
sun_conjunction_venus.summary: A harmonious blend bringing charm, sociability, and warm-heartedness.
sun_conjunction_venus.fullText: The Sun and Venus are never more than 48 degrees apart, making the conjunction their most critical aspect. It is extremely harmonious, bringing a warm-hearted, sociable, and deeply charming personality focused on love and aesthetics.

sun_semisquare_venus.title: Sun Semisquare Venus
sun_semisquare_venus.summary: Creates mild inner friction between the ego and the desire for pleasure.
sun_semisquare_venus.fullText: This mildly adverse minor aspect introduces small but persistent tensions between your core identity and your values. It precipitates minor events that force you to address how you seek romance and comfort.

sun_conjunction_mars.title: Sun Conjunct Mars
sun_conjunction_mars.summary: Fuses ego and action, creating a highly energetic and assertive nature.
sun_conjunction_mars.fullText: This dynamic aspect blends your core identity with raw passion and drive. It indicates a high energy level, making you an assertive, enterprising, and highly creative individual who readily takes initiative.

sun_opposition_mars.title: Sun Opposite Mars
sun_opposition_mars.summary: Creates intense confrontations and external challenges to your willpower.
sun_opposition_mars.fullText: This hard aspect brings your ego into direct confrontation with assertive energy. You may face opposition from others or struggle with impulsive actions, forcing you to find balance between personal desires and external conflicts.

sun_square_mars.title: Sun Square Mars
sun_square_mars.summary: A highly stressful aspect that generates intense drive through conflict.
sun_square_mars.fullText: This challenging configuration places your core identity at cross-purposes with your aggressive drive. It places obstacles in your path, teaching you lessons in patience while developing immense drive and strength of character.

sun_trine_mars.title: Sun Trine Mars
sun_trine_mars.summary: A harmonious flow of vital energy, courage, and creative action.
sun_trine_mars.fullText: This highly favorable aspect brings an easy flow between your will and your actions. It naturally enhances your courage, enterprise, and creative self-expression without requiring exhausting effort.

sun_sextile_mars.title: Sun Sextile Mars
sun_sextile_mars.summary: Provides opportunities to channel your assertive energy constructively.
sun_sextile_mars.fullText: This harmonious aspect connects your identity and passion comfortably. It brings excellent opportunities for enterprise and leadership, provided you take the initiative to act upon them.

sun_quincunx_mars.title: Sun Quincunx Mars
sun_quincunx_mars.summary: Causes unpredictable tension between your goals and your impulses.
sun_quincunx_mars.fullText: This aspect demands continual adjustments between your core identity and how you assert yourself. The incompatible energies can cause sudden impulsive actions or unpredictable strains on your physical vitality.

sun_conjunction_jupiter.title: Sun Conjunct Jupiter
sun_conjunction_jupiter.summary: Fuses identity with expansion, bringing luck, optimism, and broad vision.
sun_conjunction_jupiter.fullText: This powerful aspect blends the ego with the planet of luck and philosophy. It creates an inherently optimistic, generous personality. You possess a broad outlook on life and a natural ability to attract good fortune.

sun_opposition_jupiter.title: Sun Opposite Jupiter
sun_opposition_jupiter.summary: Brings strain through over-expansion or conflicting philosophical ideals.
sun_opposition_jupiter.fullText: This aspect pits your personal identity against the urge to expand. It can indicate a tendency to overextend yourself or face ideological conflicts with others, challenging you to moderate your boundless enthusiasm.

sun_square_jupiter.title: Sun Square Jupiter
sun_square_jupiter.summary: Creates friction between your ego and your desire for growth and abundance.
sun_square_jupiter.fullText: This stressful aspect challenges you to overcome overconfidence or excessive risk-taking. It places obstacles in your path that force you to develop discipline and refine your philosophical outlook.

sun_trine_jupiter.title: Sun Trine Jupiter
sun_trine_jupiter.summary: A highly fortunate aspect bringing innate luck and a flowing, expansive life.
sun_trine_jupiter.fullText: This is one of the most fortunate aspects in astrology. It indicates an easy, natural flow of abundance, worldly inspiration, and optimism. However, it can sometimes make you overly relaxed or prone to laziness due to sheer good luck.

sun_sextile_jupiter.title: Sun Sextile Jupiter
sun_sextile_jupiter.summary: Offers excellent opportunities for growth, education, and worldly success.
sun_sextile_jupiter.fullText: This favorable aspect opens doors for expansion and exploration. It requires you to make a conscious effort to utilize your natural optimism and philosophical insights to achieve your goals.

sun_conjunction_saturn.title: Sun Conjunct Saturn
sun_conjunction_saturn.summary: Fuses ego with discipline, creating a serious, hard-working, and responsible nature.
sun_conjunction_saturn.fullText: This conjunction blends your core identity with the taskmaster planet. It brings immense discipline, maturity, and a strong sense of duty. You may be highly ambitious but could struggle with feelings of restriction or heavy responsibility.

sun_opposition_saturn.title: Sun Opposite Saturn
sun_opposition_saturn.summary: Creates profound strain between your personal desires and external duties.
sun_opposition_saturn.fullText: This hard aspect places your identity in direct conflict with limitations and rules. It often manifests as obstacles from authority figures or heavy obligations that challenge your personal growth and demand immense patience.

sun_square_saturn.title: Sun Square Saturn
sun_square_saturn.summary: A difficult aspect that builds intense character through overcoming obstacles.
sun_square_saturn.fullText: This challenging aspect pits your willpower against severe restrictions. It creates internal frustration and inhibition, forcing you to develop tremendous drive and maturity by overcoming life's hardest lessons.

sun_trine_saturn.title: Sun Trine Saturn
sun_trine_saturn.summary: Brings a natural, easy flow of discipline, maturity, and structural success.
sun_trine_saturn.fullText: This harmonious aspect ensures your ego and your responsibilities work perfectly together. You possess innate practical endurance, reliable ambition, and the ability to build a secure, structured life with relative ease.

sun_sextile_saturn.title: Sun Sextile Saturn
sun_sextile_saturn.summary: Offers opportunities to achieve long-term goals through patient effort.
sun_sextile_saturn.fullText: This favorable aspect allows you to communicate and coordinate your personal goals with practical duties. It brings opportunities for steady advancement if you are willing to apply hard work and discipline.

sun_conjunction_uranus.title: Sun Conjunct Uranus
sun_conjunction_uranus.summary: Fuses identity with rebellion, creating a highly independent, innovative personality.
sun_conjunction_uranus.fullText: This powerful aspect blends the ego with the planet of sudden change. You possess a strong sense of independence, originality, and a revolutionary spirit. Your life path may be marked by sudden breakthroughs and unconventional choices.

sun_opposition_uranus.title: Sun Opposite Uranus
sun_opposition_uranus.summary: Creates erratic tension between your core self and the need for absolute freedom.
sun_opposition_uranus.fullText: This aspect pits your ego against sudden disruptions. It indicates unpredictable conflicts, sudden separations, and a restless urge to rebel against anything that threatens your individuality or traditions.

sun_square_uranus.title: Sun Square Uranus
sun_square_uranus.summary: A highly stressful aspect bringing sudden changes and internal nervous tension.
sun_square_uranus.fullText: This challenging aspect forces your identity to constantly adapt to erratic, revolutionary energy. It causes internal friction and sudden breakdowns, teaching you to channel your rebellious nature productively.

sun_trine_uranus.title: Sun Trine Uranus
sun_trine_uranus.summary: A harmonious flow of innovation, original thinking, and easy breakthroughs.
sun_trine_uranus.fullText: This flowing aspect allows you to integrate sudden changes and unconventional ideas with incredible ease. You possess natural visionary talents and an independent spirit that easily attracts unique opportunities.

sun_sextile_uranus.title: Sun Sextile Uranus
sun_sextile_uranus.summary: Offers exciting opportunities for growth through unconventional approaches.
sun_sextile_uranus.fullText: This favorable aspect brings chances to express your unique individuality. By putting in effort, you can use your innovative and rebellious ideas to create sudden, positive advancements in your life.

sun_conjunction_neptune.title: Sun Conjunct Neptune
sun_conjunction_neptune.summary: Fuses ego with mysticism, creating powerful artistic expression and psychic ability.
sun_conjunction_neptune.fullText: This aspect blends your core identity with imagination and spirituality. It brings fine esthetic taste, psychic potential, and a highly sensitive nature. You may struggle with boundaries but possess a profound creative vision.

sun_opposition_neptune.title: Sun Opposite Neptune
sun_opposition_neptune.summary: Creates confusing strain between your identity and deceptive or mystical forces.
sun_opposition_neptune.fullText: This hard aspect places your ego at odds with illusions. It can bring unbalanced emotions, making you susceptible to treachery, deceit, or escapism. It challenges you to find clarity amidst psychological fog.

sun_square_neptune.title: Sun Square Neptune
sun_square_neptune.summary: A challenging aspect that brings vagueness of mind and emotional vulnerability.
sun_square_neptune.fullText: This stressful aspect causes friction between your conscious will and your spiritual or escapist tendencies. It teaches hard lessons about boundaries, illusion, and overcoming self-deception in your life.

sun_trine_neptune.title: Sun Trine Neptune
sun_trine_neptune.summary: A harmonious flow of deep imagination and creative self-expression.
sun_trine_neptune.fullText: This easy aspect allows your ego and intuition to work in perfect tandem. You possess innate artistic talent, deep compassion, and a natural connection to the spiritual or mystical realms.

sun_sextile_neptune.title: Sun Sextile Neptune
sun_sextile_neptune.summary: Offers opportunities to channel your imagination into tangible artistic pursuits.
sun_sextile_neptune.fullText: This favorable aspect brings subtle opportunities for spiritual and creative growth. By actively engaging your intuition, you can successfully express your deeply sensitive and mystical nature.

sun_conjunction_pluto.title: Sun Conjunct Pluto
sun_conjunction_pluto.summary: Fuses ego with profound transformation, indicating a powerful, intense character.
sun_conjunction_pluto.fullText: This aspect blends your core identity with the planet of power and rebirth. It makes you deeply self-confident but potentially egotistical or dictatorial. You possess an intense drive to start afresh and control your environment.

sun_opposition_pluto.title: Sun Opposite Pluto
sun_opposition_pluto.summary: Creates severe strain through power struggles and intense psychological clashes.
sun_opposition_pluto.fullText: This hard aspect pits your ego against forces of destruction and control. It indicates intense confrontations with authority or manipulative individuals, challenging you to completely transform your approach to power.

sun_square_pluto.title: Sun Square Pluto
sun_square_pluto.summary: A highly stressful aspect indicating selfishness or antisocial tendencies to overcome.
sun_square_pluto.fullText: This challenging aspect brings friction between your conscious will and your deepest obsessive drives. It places heavy obstacles in your path, forcing you to refine your intense power and eliminate manipulative behaviors.

sun_trine_pluto.title: Sun Trine Pluto
sun_trine_pluto.summary: A harmonious flow of intense regenerative power and strong self-confidence.
sun_trine_pluto.fullText: This excellent aspect grants you a naturally strong character. Your ego easily harmonizes with the forces of transformation, giving you an innate ability to regenerate your life and lead with profound psychological insight.

sun_sextile_pluto.title: Sun Sextile Pluto
sun_sextile_pluto.summary: Offers opportunities to harness deep psychological power for personal growth.
sun_sextile_pluto.fullText: This favorable aspect brings chances for profound transformation. By applying your willpower, you can effectively utilize your intense focus and resilience to achieve your core goals.

sun_conjunction_chiron.title: Sun Conjunct Chiron
sun_conjunction_chiron.summary: Fuses the core identity with deep spiritual wounding and the capacity to heal.
sun_conjunction_chiron.fullText: This powerful aspect ties your ego directly to the archetype of the Wounded Healer. Your sense of self is inextricably linked to early psychological pain, but you possess an immense, focalized potential to guide and heal others through your own experiences.

sun_opposition_chiron.title: Sun Opposite Chiron
sun_opposition_chiron.summary: Creates profound strain between your identity and unhealed psychological wounds.
sun_opposition_chiron.fullText: This aspect places your conscious will in direct confrontation with your deepest insecurities. You may experience discordance by projecting your wounds onto partners, challenging you to achieve profound inner integration.

sun_square_chiron.title: Sun Square Chiron
sun_square_chiron.summary: A challenging aspect that forces you to overcome deep-seated feelings of inadequacy.
sun_square_chiron.fullText: This stressful aspect causes intense friction between your ego and your spiritual wounds. It places obstacles in your path regarding self-worth, teaching you harsh but vital lessons about self-acceptance and healing.

sun_trine_chiron.title: Sun Trine Chiron
sun_trine_chiron.summary: A harmonious flow of healing energy that naturally supports your core identity.
sun_trine_chiron.fullText: This easy aspect allows you to instinctively integrate your past wounds into a healthy sense of self. You possess an innate, flowing talent for mentoring, teaching, and offering spiritual comfort to others.

moon_conjunction_mercury.title: Moon Conjunct Mercury
moon_conjunction_mercury.summary: Fuses emotions and intellect, bringing high intelligence and vivid imagination.
moon_conjunction_mercury.fullText: This aspect perfectly blends your subconscious feelings with your logical mind. It creates a focal point of high intelligence, deep sensitivity, and a very active imagination. You naturally process emotions through conversation and thought.

moon_opposition_mercury.title: Moon Opposite Mercury
moon_opposition_mercury.summary: Creates internal strain between what you feel and what you logically think.
moon_opposition_mercury.fullText: This hard aspect brings discordance between your emotional comforts and your intellectual reasoning. You may struggle to communicate your true feelings, creating tension that challenges you to find mental and emotional balance.

moon_square_mercury.title: Moon Square Mercury
moon_square_mercury.summary: A stressful aspect indicating a high-strung, anxious, and frenetic nature.
moon_square_mercury.fullText: This challenging aspect causes intense friction between your mind and your moods. The native is inclined to be anxious and nervous, facing constant obstacles in trying to rationalize their shifting feelings.

moon_trine_mercury.title: Moon Trine Mercury
moon_trine_mercury.summary: A harmonious flow indicating common sense, shrewdness, and a witty personality.
moon_trine_mercury.fullText: This extremely favorable aspect allows your emotions and intellect to work together seamlessly. You possess innate common sense, an entertaining personality, and the ability to articulate your feelings with ease.

moon_sextile_mercury.title: Moon Sextile Mercury
moon_sextile_mercury.summary: Offers excellent opportunities to bridge emotional intelligence with communication.
moon_sextile_mercury.fullText: This harmonious aspect creates a clear channel between your mind and your heart. By applying a little effort, you can become a highly persuasive, empathetic speaker and writer.

moon_quincunx_mercury.title: Moon Quincunx Mercury
moon_quincunx_mercury.summary: Requires continual adjustment between your nervous intellect and emotional needs.
moon_quincunx_mercury.fullText: This minor but stressful aspect connects incompatible energies. You must constantly adjust your communication style to match your inner moods, which can sometimes manifest as unpredictable nervous tension or health strains.

moon_conjunction_venus.title: Moon Conjunct Venus
moon_conjunction_venus.summary: Fuses emotional security with love, bringing a friendly, tranquil nature.
moon_conjunction_venus.fullText: This beautiful aspect blends your deepest comforts with your aesthetic values. It makes you naturally friendly and brings a tranquil nature with a strong love for luxury, romance, and artistic pursuits.

moon_opposition_venus.title: Moon Opposite Venus
moon_opposition_venus.summary: Creates strain and discordance between your emotional needs and romantic desires.
moon_opposition_venus.fullText: This hard aspect pits your subconscious habits against your urge for partnership. It can indicate a tendency to seek comfort through careless self-indulgence or attract relationships that challenge your inner security.

moon_square_venus.title: Moon Square Venus
moon_square_venus.summary: A challenging aspect that can make you moody, careless, or self-indulgent.
moon_square_venus.fullText: This stressful aspect generates friction between your feelings and your values. It often brings disappointments in love affairs and requires you to overcome deep-seated moodiness and a tendency to overindulge.

moon_trine_venus.title: Moon Trine Venus
moon_trine_venus.summary: A highly harmonious aspect bringing an affectionate, lighthearted personality.
moon_trine_venus.fullText: This flowing aspect allows your emotional core and your romantic desires to support each other effortlessly. You possess a natural love of beauty, artistic talent, and an incredibly affectionate nature.

moon_sextile_venus.title: Moon Sextile Venus
moon_sextile_venus.summary: Offers wonderful opportunities for artistic expression and emotional harmony.
moon_sextile_venus.fullText: This favorable aspect opens doors for deeply fulfilling relationships and creative success. By putting your feelings into action, you can easily manifest beauty and charm in your daily life.

moon_conjunction_mars.title: Moon Conjunct Mars
moon_conjunction_mars.summary: Fuses emotion with action, creating a generous, protective, but impulsive nature.
moon_conjunction_mars.fullText: This dynamic conjunction blends your inner feelings with raw assertiveness. You are fiercely protective and need constant change. However, this intense emotional energy can sometimes make you vain or overly reactive.

moon_opposition_mars.title: Moon Opposite Mars
moon_opposition_mars.summary: Brings intense strain, emotional volatility, and conflicts with others.
moon_opposition_mars.fullText: This hard aspect pits your emotional security directly against aggressive impulses. It often manifests as sudden quarrels, extreme hypersensitivity, and defensive reactions that challenge your personal growth.

moon_square_mars.title: Moon Square Mars
moon_square_mars.summary: A stressful aspect causing friction, quick temper, and emotional outbursts.
moon_square_mars.fullText: This challenging aspect places obstacles between your feelings and your actions. It generates high inner tension, making you easily provoked and forcing you to learn patience and emotional self-control.

moon_trine_mars.title: Moon Trine Mars
moon_trine_mars.summary: A harmonious flow of vital emotional energy and courageous action.
moon_trine_mars.fullText: This easy aspect ensures your passions and your instincts work in perfect alignment. You possess innate courage, a strong constitution, and can easily express your feelings through dynamic, creative action.

moon_sextile_mars.title: Moon Sextile Mars
moon_sextile_mars.summary: Offers excellent opportunities to channel your emotions into productive enterprise.
moon_sextile_mars.fullText: This favorable aspect brings an active, spirited nature. By applying conscious effort, you can effectively defend your beliefs and use your emotional intuition to succeed in competitive environments.

moon_conjunction_jupiter.title: Moon Conjunct Jupiter
moon_conjunction_jupiter.summary: Fuses emotion with expansion, bringing deep optimism and a protective nature.
moon_conjunction_jupiter.fullText: This aspect blends your subconscious with the planet of abundance. It creates an incredibly generous, protective personality that constantly seeks new challenges. It acts as a focal point for inner faith and emotional luck.

moon_opposition_jupiter.title: Moon Opposite Jupiter
moon_opposition_jupiter.summary: Creates strain between emotional comfort and the urge for boundless expansion.
moon_opposition_jupiter.fullText: This hard aspect places your domestic security at odds with your desire to explore the world. It can indicate a tendency toward emotional extravagance or overindulgence that challenges your inner balance.

moon_square_jupiter.title: Moon Square Jupiter
moon_square_jupiter.summary: A stressful aspect that can lead to vanity, emotional gambling, or excess.
moon_square_jupiter.fullText: This challenging aspect causes friction between your feelings and your philosophical ideals. It forces you to overcome a tendency to be overly dramatic or careless with your emotional and material resources.

moon_trine_jupiter.title: Moon Trine Jupiter
moon_trine_jupiter.summary: A highly harmonious aspect bringing innate emotional ease and good fortune.
moon_trine_jupiter.fullText: This flowing aspect allows your inner needs and your desire for growth to support one another effortlessly. You possess a naturally joyous heart, deep empathy, and an inherent ability to attract luck.

moon_sextile_jupiter.title: Moon Sextile Jupiter
moon_sextile_jupiter.summary: Offers wonderful opportunities for spiritual growth and emotional abundance.
moon_sextile_jupiter.fullText: This favorable aspect brings an open, philosophical approach to your feelings. By making an effort to explore your inner world, you can easily turn your emotional generosity into tangible rewards.

moon_conjunction_saturn.title: Moon Conjunct Saturn
moon_conjunction_saturn.summary: Fuses emotion with duty, creating a thrifty, stable, but perfectionist nature.
moon_conjunction_saturn.fullText: This conjunction ties your deepest emotional needs to structure and discipline. It brings profound stability to the emotions, making you thrifty and responsible, though you may struggle with being overly critical of yourself.

moon_opposition_saturn.title: Moon Opposite Saturn
moon_opposition_saturn.summary: Creates severe strain between your feelings and your obligations.
moon_opposition_saturn.fullText: This hard aspect pits your need for nurturing against cold, practical realities. It often manifests as deep shyness, relationship blockages, or emotional isolation that forces you to build profound internal resilience.

moon_square_saturn.title: Moon Square Saturn
moon_square_saturn.summary: A highly challenging aspect bringing shyness, money problems, and self-doubt.
moon_square_saturn.fullText: This stressful aspect places heavy obstacles in the way of your emotional fulfillment. It requires you to overcome a chronic lack of self-confidence, potential material hardships, and trouble in early partnerships.

moon_trine_saturn.title: Moon Trine Saturn
moon_trine_saturn.summary: A harmonious flow indicating a diplomatic, ambitious, and conservative nature.
moon_trine_saturn.fullText: This easy aspect allows your emotions and responsibilities to work together perfectly. You possess innate patience, immense practical thoroughness, and the emotional maturity needed to achieve your ambitions.

moon_sextile_saturn.title: Moon Sextile Saturn
moon_sextile_saturn.summary: Offers excellent opportunities to build enduring emotional security through effort.
moon_sextile_saturn.fullText: This favorable aspect brings a disciplined approach to your feelings. By patiently applying yourself, you can establish strong, stable foundations in both your personal relationships and your career.

moon_quincunx_saturn.title: Moon Quincunx Saturn
moon_quincunx_saturn.summary: Requires continual, stressful adjustments between your feelings and your duties.
moon_quincunx_saturn.fullText: This minor but difficult aspect connects fundamentally incompatible energies. You may feel a persistent, uncomfortable strain where your need for comfort is constantly interrupted by heavy responsibilities, often affecting your health.

moon_conjunction_uranus.title: Moon Conjunct Uranus
moon_conjunction_uranus.summary: Fuses emotion with rebellion, creating strong intuition but sudden mood changes.
moon_conjunction_uranus.fullText: This powerful aspect blends your inner security with the planet of sudden shocks. You are open to the future and possess brilliant intuition, but your emotional life is prone to highly erratic, unpredictable shifts.

moon_opposition_uranus.title: Moon Opposite Uranus
moon_opposition_uranus.summary: Creates intense, erratic strain between your need for comfort and absolute freedom.
moon_opposition_uranus.fullText: This hard aspect pits your domestic stability against a rebellious urge for independence. It often indicates sudden separations, unpredictable relationship dynamics, and a strong inner tension that challenges your emotional grounding.

moon_square_uranus.title: Moon Square Uranus
moon_square_uranus.summary: A challenging aspect that brings high nervous tension and emotional instability.
moon_square_uranus.fullText: This stressful aspect causes severe friction between your feelings and sudden changes. It places obstacles in your path, forcing you to cope with a highly temperamental nature and unpredictable domestic upheavals.

moon_trine_uranus.title: Moon Trine Uranus
moon_trine_uranus.summary: A harmonious flow of brilliant intuition and progressive emotional openness.
moon_trine_uranus.fullText: This easy aspect allows your subconscious to effortlessly integrate unconventional ideas. You possess an innate, forward-thinking emotional nature that embraces change and naturally attracts unique, exciting experiences.

moon_sextile_uranus.title: Moon Sextile Uranus
moon_sextile_uranus.summary: Offers opportunities to revitalize your emotional life through innovative changes.
moon_sextile_uranus.fullText: This favorable aspect brings flashes of brilliant insight. By making a conscious effort to break old habits, you can successfully harness your strong intuition to create a highly progressive, liberated life.

moon_conjunction_neptune.title: Moon Conjunct Neptune
moon_conjunction_neptune.summary: Fuses emotion with mysticism, creating an incredibly sensitive, artistic nature.
moon_conjunction_neptune.fullText: This conjunction completely dissolves the boundaries of the subconscious. It acts as a powerful focal point for psychic sensitivity, deep compassion, and profound artistic talent, though it can also bring a desire for seclusion.

moon_opposition_neptune.title: Moon Opposite Neptune
moon_opposition_neptune.summary: Creates strain between your true feelings and powerful illusions or escapism.
moon_opposition_neptune.fullText: This hard aspect pits your emotional security against confusing, deceptive forces. It challenges you to navigate through emotional vagueness and a susceptibility to being easily led astray by others or by your own fantasies.

moon_square_neptune.title: Moon Square Neptune
moon_square_neptune.summary: A stressful aspect that can lead to extreme emotional vulnerability and deceit.
moon_square_neptune.fullText: This challenging aspect causes intense friction between your reality and your dreams. It places psychological obstacles in your path, requiring you to learn hard lessons about boundaries, escapism, and unbalanced emotions.

moon_trine_neptune.title: Moon Trine Neptune
moon_trine_neptune.summary: A harmonious flow of pure empathy, psychic ability, and creative imagination.
moon_trine_neptune.fullText: This flowing aspect allows your subconscious and your spiritual ideals to work together perfectly. You possess innate artistic potential, gentle compassion, and an ethereal emotional nature that deeply comforts others.

moon_sextile_neptune.title: Moon Sextile Neptune
moon_sextile_neptune.summary: Offers subtle opportunities for spiritual and artistic emotional expression.
moon_sextile_neptune.fullText: This favorable aspect creates a gentle connection between your feelings and your intuition. By actively utilizing your sensitivity, you can successfully channel your vivid imagination into beautiful, creative works.

moon_conjunction_pluto.title: Moon Conjunct Pluto
moon_conjunction_pluto.summary: Fuses emotion with absolute transformation, leading to intense, impulsive changes.
moon_conjunction_pluto.fullText: This intense aspect blends your deepest security needs with the forces of death and rebirth. You possess a magnetically powerful emotional core, but are prone to sudden eruptions and making thoughtless, drastic moves.

moon_opposition_pluto.title: Moon Opposite Pluto
moon_opposition_pluto.summary: Creates terrifying emotional strain, power struggles, and psychological extremes.
moon_opposition_pluto.fullText: This hard aspect pits your vulnerability directly against destructive or controlling forces. It indicates intense relationship crises and a tendency toward brooding jealousy that forces profound emotional regeneration.

moon_square_pluto.title: Moon Square Pluto
moon_square_pluto.summary: A highly challenging aspect causing extreme mood swings and prominent jealousy.
moon_square_pluto.fullText: This stressful aspect generates severe friction in your subconscious. It brings unpleasant, sudden changes to your domestic life and requires you to completely overhaul obsessive, manipulative, or intensely jealous emotional patterns.

uranus_trine_chiron.title: Uranus Trine Chiron
uranus_trine_chiron.summary: A harmonious flow of healing energy that naturally stabilizes your eccentric genius.
uranus_trine_chiron.fullText: This easy aspect allows your originality to effortlessly integrate past social traumas. You possess an innate, flowing talent for inspiring humanitarian networks and bridging the deepest existential gaps for those who feel like outsiders.

neptune_conjunction_pluto.title: Neptune Conjunct Pluto
neptune_conjunction_pluto.summary: Fuses mysticism with absolute transformation, leading to profound, terrifying psychic depth.
neptune_conjunction_pluto.fullText: This incredibly rare generational aspect blends the collective unconscious with the forces of death and rebirth. It acts as a focal point for immense spiritual regeneration, uncovering the darkest occult secrets and dissolving the ultimate taboos of existence.

neptune_opposition_pluto.title: Neptune Opposite Pluto
neptune_opposition_pluto.summary: Creates terrifying spiritual strain, brutal psychological struggles, and mass paranoia.
neptune_opposition_pluto.fullText: This hard aspect pits your boundless empathy directly against destructive or controlling forces. It indicates intense, violent occult confrontations and a tendency toward deep-seated mass delusion that forces humanity to completely overhaul its connection to the divine.

neptune_square_pluto.title: Neptune Square Pluto
neptune_square_pluto.summary: A highly challenging aspect causing extreme obsessive fantasies and ruthless spiritual destruction.
neptune_square_pluto.fullText: This stressful aspect generates severe friction in the collective soul. It brings unpleasant, sudden crises to the spiritual order and requires society to overcome toxic sexual or financial deception and the destructive urge to dominate the unknown.

neptune_trine_pluto.title: Neptune Trine Pluto
neptune_trine_pluto.summary: A harmonious flow of intense psychic resilience and profound regenerative healing.
neptune_trine_pluto.fullText: This easy aspect allows you to navigate complex, transformative occult mysteries with incredible ease. You possess naturally strong, deeply probing mystical instincts and an innate ability to rebuild shattered psyches from the ashes.

neptune_sextile_pluto.title: Neptune Sextile Pluto
neptune_sextile_pluto.summary: Offers powerful opportunities for spiritual rebirth and uncovering hidden mystical wealth.
neptune_sextile_pluto.fullText: This favorable aspect connects your compassion with your regenerative power. By making a conscious effort to face your deepest fears, you can successfully transform your intuition and gain immense, purifying influence over reality.

neptune_conjunction_chiron.title: Neptune Conjunct Chiron
neptune_conjunction_chiron.summary: Fuses mysticism with deep spiritual wounding, creating a profoundly empathetic, sacrificial healer.
neptune_conjunction_chiron.fullText: This aspect ties your boundless empathy directly to the archetype of the Wounded Healer. Your dreams are intensely linked to an early feeling of universal sorrow, creating a focal point for brilliantly guiding others toward divine grace.

neptune_opposition_chiron.title: Neptune Opposite Chiron
neptune_opposition_chiron.summary: Creates profound strain between your spiritual ideals and unhealed emotional boundaries.
neptune_opposition_chiron.fullText: This hard aspect places your absolute compassion in direct conflict with your spiritual wounds. You may experience discordance by absorbing the pain of others to quiet your own grief, challenging you to embrace psychological grounding.

neptune_square_chiron.title: Neptune Square Chiron
neptune_square_chiron.summary: A challenging aspect that forces you to confront a paralyzing fear of worldly suffering.
neptune_square_chiron.fullText: This stressful aspect causes intense friction in your spiritual life. It places obstacles in your path regarding your boundaries, teaching you vital lessons about overcoming severe escapism, addiction, or a chronic martyr complex.

neptune_trine_chiron.title: Neptune Trine Chiron
neptune_trine_chiron.summary: A harmonious flow of healing energy that naturally stabilizes your mystical empathy.
neptune_trine_chiron.fullText: This easy aspect allows your imagination to effortlessly integrate past collective traumas. You possess an innate, flowing talent for inspiring divine compassion and bridging the deepest existential gaps for those who feel completely lost.

pluto_conjunction_chiron.title: Pluto Conjunct Chiron
pluto_conjunction_chiron.summary: Fuses absolute transformation with deep spiritual wounding, creating a terrifyingly resilient healer.
pluto_conjunction_chiron.fullText: This aspect ties your regenerative power directly to the archetype of the Wounded Healer. Your survival instincts are intensely linked to early betrayal or trauma, creating a focal point for brilliantly guiding others through ultimate psychological rebirth.

pluto_opposition_chiron.title: Pluto Opposite Chiron
pluto_opposition_chiron.summary: Creates profound strain between your need for control and unhealed psychological terror.
pluto_opposition_chiron.fullText: This hard aspect places your absolute power in direct conflict with your spiritual wounds. You may experience discordance by projecting your paranoia onto others to quiet your own fears, challenging you to embrace complete vulnerability.

pluto_square_chiron.title: Pluto Square Chiron
pluto_square_chiron.summary: A challenging aspect that forces you to confront a paralyzing fear of betrayal or death.
pluto_square_chiron.fullText: This stressful aspect causes intense friction in your psychological life. It places obstacles in your path regarding your trust, teaching you vital lessons about overcoming destructive obsession, vindictiveness, and the urge to dominate your intimate partners.

pluto_trine_chiron.title: Pluto Trine Chiron
pluto_trine_chiron.summary: A harmonious flow of healing energy that naturally stabilizes your profound regenerative power.
pluto_trine_chiron.fullText: This easy aspect allows your survival instincts to effortlessly integrate past psychological traumas. You possess an innate, flowing talent for inspiring ultimate transformation and bridging the deepest existential gaps for those who feel emotionally destroyed.

sun_sextile_chiron.title: Sun Sextile Chiron
sun_sextile_chiron.summary: Opportunity to integrate the core identity with the wounded healer's gift.
sun_sextile_chiron.fullText: The sextile between Sun and Chiron offers a workable channel between who you are and where you have been hurt. Identity is not defined by the wound, but the wound becomes usable material — often the basis of a vocation in which your own history qualifies you to help. The aspect requires deliberate effort; it opens a door rather than pushing you through it.

moon_sextile_chiron.title: Moon Sextile Chiron
moon_sextile_chiron.summary: A gentle opening between emotional life and the capacity to heal others.
moon_sextile_chiron.fullText: Feelings and old injury sit at a productive angle here. You register other people's pain accurately without being flooded by it, which makes you unusually useful in situations of distress. The opportunity is to let emotional memory inform care rather than dictate mood. Left unused, it simply remains latent sensitivity.

mercury_sextile_chiron.title: Mercury Sextile Chiron
mercury_sextile_chiron.summary: The ability to put difficult experience into words that help others.
mercury_sextile_chiron.fullText: This aspect connects thought and articulation to the place where you were wounded, producing a real talent for describing pain precisely — in conversation, teaching, writing, or counsel. What was inarticulate becomes communicable. The effort required is willingness to speak about the injury at all; the aspect rewards that choice rather than forcing it.

venus_sextile_chiron.title: Venus Sextile Chiron
venus_sextile_chiron.summary: Relationship and creative work opened as routes to repair.
venus_sextile_chiron.fullText: Venus sextile Chiron offers healing through connection and through making things. Affection given and received acts on old injury without either party needing to name the process, and creative work frequently carries the same function. The aspect inclines you toward partners and friendships in which vulnerability is workable rather than dangerous.

mars_sextile_chiron.title: Mars Sextile Chiron
mars_sextile_chiron.summary: Constructive action available as the answer to old injury.
mars_sextile_chiron.fullText: Here the drive to act finds a productive angle to the wound, so that effort becomes remedial rather than merely compensatory. You can fight for causes connected to your own history without the fight being purely a re-enactment. The opportunity is deliberate, applied courage; the aspect does not supply the initiative, only the opening.

jupiter_sextile_chiron.title: Jupiter Sextile Chiron
jupiter_sextile_chiron.summary: Meaning and perspective offered as the frame that makes the wound bearable.
jupiter_sextile_chiron.fullText: Jupiter sextile Chiron makes it possible to place personal injury inside a larger philosophical or spiritual account, which is often what converts pain into something teachable. Generosity increases as a direct result of what you have survived. The risk of the easy aspect is complacent explanation rather than genuine integration.

saturn_sextile_chiron.title: Saturn Sextile Chiron
saturn_sextile_chiron.summary: Patient structure made available for the long work of repair.
saturn_sextile_chiron.fullText: This aspect supplies discipline and realistic timeframes to healing that cannot be rushed. You are able to build durable practices — routines, commitments, professional structures — that hold the wound steadily rather than resolving it dramatically. Slow, unglamorous, and genuinely effective when the effort is actually made.

uranus_sextile_chiron.title: Uranus Sextile Chiron
uranus_sextile_chiron.summary: Unconventional approaches opened toward what conventional means could not reach.
uranus_sextile_chiron.fullText: Uranus sextile Chiron favours the unorthodox remedy: the method, community, or insight arrived at sideways rather than through established channels. Sudden reframings can relieve long-standing injury. The aspect asks you to try the approach others consider improbable, and rewards experiment over orthodoxy.

neptune_sextile_chiron.title: Neptune Sextile Chiron
neptune_sextile_chiron.summary: Compassion and imagination offered as instruments of healing.
neptune_sextile_chiron.fullText: Here the boundary between your own pain and others' becomes usefully porous rather than dissolving entirely. Art, music, contemplative practice, and straightforward mercy all become available as means of repair. The caution is that Neptune can substitute consolation for change; the sextile works when the softness is paired with something concrete.

pluto_sextile_chiron.title: Pluto Sextile Chiron
pluto_sextile_chiron.summary: Access to deep transformation of what was injured.
pluto_sextile_chiron.fullText: Pluto sextile Chiron offers a workable route into material most people cannot face directly, allowing genuine reconstruction rather than management. You can go to the root of an old injury and survive the descent. The opportunity is real depth work, undertaken by choice rather than forced by crisis.
